result.summary: E4/E5 real-path drill harnesses built, validated and evidenced without enabling Stage 2. exec-brain/e4e5_drill_harness.py drives the real execution abstractions (E3ProductionExecutor, ExecutionAdapterRegistry, OrchestrationStore schema v2, CapabilityRegistry, EquivalentFailover, CheckpointManager, SafeModeManager, ConvergenceEnforcer, MalformedOutputHandler, SafeModeRecovery) against a disposable isolated schema-v2 DB with provider transport replaced by a recorded in-process stub: D1 checkpoint create/restore + equivalent-worker failover (deepseek-v41-flash -> codex-cli, both QUALIFIED in the live registry read via snapshot copy) with the restored checkpoint delivered to the replacement, which reached COMPLETE only after a verification PASS; D2 no-equivalent -> owner escalation, quality floor NOT lowered; D3 provider outage (reported HTTP 503 and raised transport error) both leave the node FAILED with the error verbatim and no failover claimed; D4 malformed output rejected by the deterministic verifier with a repair path to a verified COMPLETE; D5 convergence cap bounded at exactly 3 dispatches (no 4th), quarantine + escalated convergence event, DEGRADED->SAFE_MODE entry; D6 safe-mode entry, owner-override audit (owner-only trigger not auto-resolved) and recovery refused without an override or when the probe is unhealthy, then succeeding to NORMAL with 0 active events. 33/33 checks, real_provider_calls=0, stub_dispatches=10, live orchestration.db/governor.db/exec_brain.db SHA-256 unchanged, 0 live E2 rows, artifact labelled stubbed_provider_failure (never presented as real external provider evidence). Added the E5 owner-override/recovery capability to safe_mode.py. Two real defects found and fixed: OrchestrationStore.connect() leaked the init_db connection (locking the store DB on Windows after close), and the harness's first revision created stray orchestration.db-shm/-wal sidecars in the deployed runtime dir by opening the live WAL store (now reads a snapshot copy; sidecars removed; the intermediate failed 14/15 regression bundle preserved under audits/evidence/superseded/ with its reason). All 15 regressions pass. Stage 2 NOT ENABLED, nothing deployed, no VPS action. Both background evidence runs are accounted for and the tree is in sync with origin/main at b949db5.
